address: 22 Zhiguang Street, Yonghe District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Thanks to floor-to-ceiling windows, diners can sit back and appreciate the beauty of a century-old camellia tree in the yard. The menu is mostly Hakkanese, with some Jiangzhe dishes, jazzed up by creative touches and elegant plating. The signature braised pork belly with dry pickled mustard greens boasts tender texture and succulent flavours, while pickled cucumber cuts through the richness. Also try braised napa cabbage with pork-stuffed tofu.
